I will buy two bags of fertilizer from the cooperative for this plot—one of DAP and one of urea—but that is not enough for the full recommended amount, so I will also put manure from my oxen and cows. I have my own seed saved from last season, so I will not spend money on improved seed from the market. We do not spray chemicals on this land, and there is no water for irrigation here in the highlands. My wife and children will work this plot with me for about two months, and I will hire a few day laborers when the weeding and harvest are heavy.
